description: Which rung of the model ladder a machine gets. The ladder is in quality order and the pick is the best rung that fits: a dense rung by its VRAM, an MoE by card and RAM together with a card minimum, a Mac by its unified memory. `vram` is GB, with the strings NaN for an unmeasured card. `target` carries platform, arch, ram (GB) and cpuModel; missing keys are absent. getRecommendedDownload's size is bytes, rounded. The MLX ladder and modelRecommendations are aliases of the one ladder and are not separate cases.
